		looking_for_a = situation
		interaction_source_list = {
			situation:oe_sit_v47_samarkand_renaissance = {
				add_to_list = source
			}
		}
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_situation"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			situation:oe_sit_v47_samarkand_renaissance = this
			situation_is_active = yes
		}
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_gold = -120
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v47_mod_silk_caravanserai_net years = 12 mode = replace }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v47_samarkand_patron value = 1 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v47_eu2_18_seen } } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_eu2_18_seen value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_v47_eu2.18 }
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v47_timurid_cohesion } } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_timurid_cohesion value = 45 } }
			change_variable = { name = oe_v47_timurid_cohesion add = 9 }
			if = { limit = { var:oe_v47_timurid_cohesion > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_timurid_cohesion value = 100 } }
			if = { limit = { var:oe_v47_timurid_cohesion < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_timurid_cohesion value = 0 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v47_samarkand_science } } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_samarkand_science value = 35 } }
			change_variable = { name = oe_v47_samarkand_science add = 5 }
			if = { limit = { var:oe_v47_samarkand_science > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_samarkand_science value = 100 } }
			if = { limit = { var:oe_v47_samarkand_science < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_samarkand_science value = 0 } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = oe_v47_act_sam_silk_caravanserai_tt
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		add = 8
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed } add = 18 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed } } add = -4 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { gold >= 300 } } add = 12 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { gold < 180 } } add = -12 }
	}
}
